job.snapshotSchedule: Daily at 4:00 AM Eastern (3:00 AM Central)
job.digestSchedule: Mondays at 9:00 AM Eastern (8:00 AM Central)

aiDispatchStart.evidence: First delivered load through the AI email path; 4 such loads in the 14 days from 2026-04-13.

metrics.label: Freight moved (stated weights)
metrics.definition: Total stated weight of delivered loads, in short tons of 2,000 lb.

coverage.what: Delivered loads with a stated weight

metrics.label: Freight moved (estimated, all loads)
metrics.definition: Stated weights plus an estimate for delivered loads with no stated weight.
assumptions: Loads with no stated weight are assumed to weigh the average of loads that state one.

coverage.what: Delivered loads with a stated weight (the rest are estimated)

metrics.label: Loads delivered
metrics.definition: Loads with a delivered, completed or POD received status, by delivery month.

comparisons.label: Last 3 months vs a year earlier

coverage.what: Delivered loads with a usable date

metrics.label: Gross load revenue
metrics.definition: Gross revenue of delivered loads per month, as the Financials ledger records it.

comparisons.label: Last 3 months vs a year earlier

coverage.what: Months with ledger records

metrics.label: Miles driven (ELD)
metrics.definition: Miles from the trucks’ ELD devices, summed per month.

comparisons.label: vs September 2025
comparisons.display: No ELD records a year earlier

coverage.what: Days with ELD miles since the first ELD record

metrics.label: On-time deliveries
metrics.definition: Share of judged deliveries that arrived at the receiver by the appointment time.
warnings: Recorded appointments are not updated when a load is rescheduled; review before publishing.

coverage.what: Delivered loads with an arrival and an appointment

breakdown.label: On time by day (arrival day on or before the appointment day)

metrics.label: Trucks in fleet
metrics.definition: Trucks in service on the day, from each truck’s service dates.

comparisons.label: vs September 2025
comparisons.display: No fleet records a year earlier

coverage.what: Trucks with a service start date

metrics.label: Active units (drivers with a delivered load)
metrics.definition: Distinct drivers with at least one delivered load in the month.
assumptions: Stands in for fleet size before truck records exist; early drivers may be partner carriers.

coverage.what: Delivered loads with a usable date

metrics.label: Fleet fuel economy
metrics.definition: ELD miles divided by receipt gallons, over months that have both.

coverage.what: Fuel receipts with gallons

metrics.label: Diesel dollars saved vs baseline
metrics.definition: What the same ELD miles would have cost at the baseline MPG, less what the fuel actually cost.
assumptions: Compared with a truck at the baseline MPG set on this page driving the same ELD miles, priced at the average $/gal actually paid.

coverage.what: Months with ELD miles and fuel receipts

metrics.label: Carbon output (tailpipe CO2)
metrics.definition: Receipt gallons of diesel times 10.18 kg of CO2 per gallon, in metric tonnes.
assumptions: Tailpipe CO2 only, from receipt gallons; gallons for trailer refrigeration units on the same receipts are included.

source.label: U.S. EPA, Greenhouse Gas Emissions from a Typical Passenger Vehicle

coverage.what: Fuel receipts with gallons

metrics.label: Tasks handled by AI
metrics.definition: Rate confirmations read from email, receipts read by AI and AI expense insights, counted per month.

coverage.what: Months since the AI email path started

metrics.label: Tasks handled by automation (rules, not AI)
metrics.definition: Geofence status changes and automatic invoice runs, counted per month.

coverage.what: Months with automation records

metrics.label: Dispatch calls handled by AI
metrics.missingReason: No call or voice system records dispatch calls.
metrics.definition: Dispatch phone calls answered by an AI agent.

coverage.what: Call records

metrics.label: Truck utilization (active days)
metrics.definition: Share of truck-days in the fleet with more than one ELD mile.

beforeAfter.note: Needs at least 14 truck-days on both sides; there are no ELD records before the AI dispatch start.
Set the dedicated contracts start date in the KPI settings.

coverage.what: Truck-days with an ELD feed

metrics.label: Paid-mile share (paid ÷ total ELD miles)
metrics.definition: Paid miles on the rate confirmations (line haul plus empty movement) divided by all miles the fleet's ELD trucks drove.

beforeAfter.note: Whole months: up to 3 complete months on each side of the contract month, each with at least 90% of its loads' paid miles fully known.

coverage.what: Delivered loads with ELD miles on both legs

metrics.label: Loaded miles
metrics.definition: Loaded miles of delivered loads: the miles the rate confirmation states, else Google's lane distance between the stated addresses.

coverage.what: delivered loads with known loaded miles

breakdown.label: Loaded miles stated on the rate confirmation

metrics.label: Paid miles (rate confirmations)
metrics.definition: Miles the rate confirmations pay for: line haul plus empty movement.

coverage.what: delivered loads whose paid miles are fully known

metrics.label: Deadhead miles
metrics.definition: Empty movement the rate confirmations state, else the route distance from the truck's previous delivery to this pickup. Not the miles driven.

coverage.what: delivered loads with a deadhead figure

breakdown.label: Empty movement stated on the rate confirmation

metrics.label: Unloaded miles (ELD total minus loaded)
metrics.definition: All miles the fleet's ELD trucks drove minus the loaded miles of their delivered loads.

coverage.what: delivered loads with known loaded miles
